entries.14c6738f28e341a1: This is the company's single segment. As designated disability welfare services under the Act on Comprehensive Support for Persons with Disabilities, it provides employment transition support, employment retention support, designated planning consultation support and self-reliance training (life training), and as of June 30, 2026, it operates a total of 133 locations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥7,112 million; sales by service were ¥5,613 million for employment transition, employment retention, employment choice and designated planning consultation support services, ¥1,458 million for self-reliance training (life training) services, and ¥40 million for other services. This business receives compensation from government agencies and users in exchange for support provided to persons with disabilities who use the services.
entries.24dcea10510dc20a: These are the main services. Employment transition support is a service in which persons with disabilities undergo training for employment, acquire the knowledge and skills needed to work, and are supported so they can remain in the workplace after finding a job; there are 87 facilities. Employment retention support is a service in which, for persons with disabilities in general employment, life-related challenges are identified through consultation and liaison with companies and relevant organizations is carried out so they can stay in the workplace over the long term; it is operated at 74 locations within employment transition support facilities. Designated planning consultation support is a service that provides consultation on using welfare services and prepares plans suited to individual goals, and 6 locations are operated. Cumulatively, more than 6,000 people have found employment, and the employment retention rate is 87.9%. It is characterized by broad acceptance, including admission of people attending only about 2 days a week; 'individual' support through more than 600 types of programs; and 'support' that respects self-determination.

entries.cedcbfb0a84a8528: Self-Reliance Training (Life Training) Service Specializing in Rework “Cocorport Rework”
entries.f684fc921c834723: This self-reliance training (life training) service, launched in April 2024, specializes in supporting the return to work of people who have taken leave due to mental health problems. It operates 9 facilities under the name “Cocorport Rework.” It sets out support to restore balance among the three circles of “Will Can Must” and supports the process up to return to work in four steps.
entries.f79a8e2eedb5fba5: This self-reliance training (life training) service was launched in April 2020. It provides support, including training and advice to maintain and improve living skills, so that persons with disabilities can lead independent daily and social lives. Designed to address the social issue of 'hikikomori' (social withdrawal), the service operates 37 facilities under the name “Cocorport College.” It offers more than 450 types of programs and supports post-graduation pathways leading to employment transition support services.
